title: Apply ruff's I001 import sorting (with force-single-line)
body:
These are automated changes from ruff version 0.16.10, using:

```
$ ruff check --fix --fixable I001 --select I001 --config "lint.isort.force-single-line = true" HEAD is now at 072b11ff5 Fix d105 docstrings (#5338) Found 101 errors (101 fixed, 0 remaining).
```

This is essentially a repeat of #4662, but is part of the larger set of changes I started in #5354 which was too big to easily review. The idea here is to apply the sensible changes in stages with the hope of adopting the newer ruff soon.
